QuestInfo.name: [FriendStory] Un-Squidding-Believable
QuestInfo.0: Everyone is excited about the Legendary Mr. Handsome coming to the school as a student teacher. So what's this call from Neinheart about? Answer him.
QuestInfo.1: Neinheart said something about Hawkeye. Meet Neinheart in the Office to see what is happening.
QuestInfo.2: Hawkeye's story is insane. Could the new student teacher have something to do with it? Speak to Neinheart to get more information.
